description: Trello REST API client wrapper. API key + token passed as query-string parameters on every request (Trello has no header-based auth).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Trello API key.

api_token_env_var.label: Api Token Env Var
api_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the Trello API token.
